personalInfo.name: Monkey D. Luffy
personalInfo.title: Future Pirate King
personalInfo.bio: Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates, adventurer, and lover of meat. Sailing the Grand Line in search of the One Piece!
personalInfo.circularText: MONKEY D. LUFFY • PIRATE KING • STRAW HAT •
personalInfo.aboutMeIntro: Hi! I'm Monkey D. Luffy, captain of the Straw Hat Pirates and future King of the Pirates! I love adventure, my friends, and especially meat. I ate the Gum-Gum Devil Fruit, so my body stretches like rubber! I'm sailing the Grand Line with my amazing crew, searching for the legendary One Piece treasure. I believe in freedom, friendship, and never giving up on your dreams. If you want to join my crew, you better have a dream and be ready for the adventure of a lifetime! Shishishi!
aboutMeDetailed: Luffy set sail from Foosha Village to find the legendary treasure, One Piece. Along the way, he gathered a loyal crew, defeated powerful enemies, and made friends all over the world.
When not fighting Marines or rival pirates, Luffy enjoys eating, napping, and having fun with his crew. He believes in freedom, friendship, and never giving up on his dreams!
Luffy possesses the power of the Gum-Gum Fruit, making his body stretch like rubber. He's also mastered all three types of Haki, making him one of the most formidable pirates on the seas.
He has a knack for turning enemies into allies, inspiring others with his unwavering spirit and simple honesty.
Luffy has a bounty that keeps rising, currently one of the highest in the world, and is recognized as one of the Worst Generation.
He has led the Straw Hat Pirates through legendary battles at places like Alabasta, Enies Lobby, Marineford, Dressrosa, Whole Cake Island, and Wano.
Luffy's dream is not just to find the One Piece, but to live a life of complete freedom and help his friends achieve their dreams too.
Favorite foods: Meat (all kinds), fish, and anything Sanji cooks!
Famous catchphrases: 'I'm gonna be King of the Pirates!' and 'I want to eat meat!'
personalInfo.projectsPageIntro: Check out my greatest adventures and pirate achievements! Each project brought me closer to my dream of becoming Pirate King.
personalInfo.sideProjectsPageIntro: Some of the wild side quests and inventions my crew and I have tackled on our journey!
personalInfo.productsPageIntro: Explore the unique gadgets, ships, and treasures we've collected or built during our adventures!
personalInfo.hireMePageSubtitle: Got a dream? Want to sail the Grand Line? Send me a message and maybe you can join the Straw Hat Pirates!

project-going-merry.name: Going Merry Ship Upgrade
project-going-merry.description: Major upgrades and repairs to the Straw Hats' first pirate ship, the Going Merry.
project-going-merry.tagline: The Going Merry carried us through countless adventures. She was more than a ship—she was our friend!
project-going-merry.overview: After many battles and storms, the Going Merry needed serious repairs. With the help of the Water 7 shipwrights (and Usopp's determination), we gave her one last epic journey.

problemStatement.title: Ship in Trouble!
problemStatement.description: Our beloved ship was falling apart after so many adventures. We needed to fix her or risk losing our way to the Grand Line!

project-meat-inventory.name: Meat Inventory App
project-meat-inventory.description: A handy app to track all the meat supplies on the Thousand Sunny.
project-meat-inventory.tagline: Never run out of meat again!
project-meat-inventory.overview: Sanji was tired of Luffy eating all the meat, so we built an app to keep track of supplies. Now, everyone gets their fair share (except when I get hungry).

problemStatement.title: Where's the Meat?
problemStatement.description: Meat kept disappearing from the kitchen. We needed a way to track it and keep Luffy honest!

project-crew-recruitment.name: Pirate Crew Recruitment Portal
project-crew-recruitment.description: A portal for recruiting new Straw Hat Pirates with big dreams.
project-crew-recruitment.tagline: Got a dream? Join my crew!
project-crew-recruitment.overview: We needed more nakama for our journey. This portal lets dreamers from all over the world apply to join the Straw Hat Pirates. Only those with true spirit make the cut!

problemStatement.title: Need More Nakama!
problemStatement.description: The Grand Line is tough. We need strong, loyal friends to help us reach the end!

project-grand-line-map.name: Grand Line Navigation System
project-grand-line-map.description: A high-tech map and log pose tracker for navigating the Grand Line.
project-grand-line-map.tagline: Never get lost again! (Unless Luffy's steering)
project-grand-line-map.overview: Nami built a navigation system to help us survive the Grand Line's crazy weather and islands. Now we only get lost when Luffy ignores her directions!

problemStatement.title: Lost at Sea
problemStatement.description: The Grand Line is full of surprises. We needed a way to track our journey and avoid danger!

side-1.name: Wanted Poster Generator
side-1.description: Create your own pirate wanted poster! Upload a photo and get your bounty.
side-1.tagline: Make yourself look dangerous — even if you just ate meat.
side-1.overview: A fun demo product page showing how side projects can open a full details view in this portfolio template.
keyFeatures: Upload a face and generate a poster

side-2.name: Devil Fruit Encyclopedia
side-2.description: Browse all known Devil Fruits and their powers. Beware of side effects!
side-2.tagline: Know every fruit before you bite it.
side-2.overview: Example product with richer metadata for the details page.

side-3.name: Zoro's Sword Tracker
side-3.description: Keep track of all swords Zoro has owned (and lost).
side-3.tagline: Never lose a sword again (or do, and still track it).
side-3.overview: Demo of Play Store metrics badges (downloads + average rating) on product cards and detail pages.
keyFeatures: Log every sword in the collection

side-4.name: Chopper's Medical Kit
side-4.description: A digital guide to Chopper's favorite remedies and medicines.
